summary: Destructor for a composite network/physics/IO object. Installs the IOOps vtable (off_5B8A68) at this+0x0, tears down a network subsystem (sub_57E530, NetworkCleanup_fbe0), then walks a repeating guard-byte / HANDLE pattern: for each of eight handle slots the code closes the Win32 handle with CloseHandle when its guard byte (and the handle) are set and zeroes the slot on success. Interleaved with the handle cleanup it destroys linked-list and buffer sub-objects (LinkedBufferCleanup, sub_582CE0, sub_582A10, sub_582650, LinkedListCleanup x2, LinkedListDestroyWithVtableDestructorCall, CloseHandleWrapper + LinkedListDestructionWithVTableReleaseCall on +2760, CloseHandleWrapper + LinkedListFreeStandard on +2732, FreeIfNonNull at this+0xA78). Finally it swaps in the physics vtable off_5B8A00 at this+0x940 and chains into sub_583AE0(this), whose result is the return value.
